_about: Modules that backend/scripts/check_module_tests.py (gate step 6, spec 16.1) accepts without a test of their own. Every entry says WHY: which suite exercises the module instead, or which phase builds and tests it. Adding an entry is a decision, not a convenience - a module that can be unit-tested gets a unit test. Keys are paths (backend ones relative to backend/, the way the coverage report names them); a directory key covers the modules inside it. The gate fails on an entry whose module no longer exists and reports entries that have since gained tests.

backend.app/api/deps.py: FastAPI dependencies (session, CSRF-safe acting context, rate-limit keys) run on every API request; tests/security/test_authz_matrix.py drives every route × role through them.
backend.app/api/v1/auth.py: Route layer of the auth services; covered end to end by tests/security/test_login_sessions.py, test_registration_verification.py and test_admin_totp.py.
backend.app/api/v1/me.py: Account reads used by tests/security/test_registration_verification.py (status, verification flags) and the profile suites.
backend.app/core/idempotency.py: Idempotency keys for money endpoints; Phase 10 builds the endpoints that use them and tests replay there (the module is unused until then, 0 % coverage, noted in docs/TESTING.md).
backend.app/core/metrics.py: Prometheus middleware; tests/api/test_app.py asserts /metrics is served with route templates and tests/edge/test_edge.py that Nginx blocks it from outside.
backend.app/db/base.py: Declarative base, naming conventions and column mixins — no behaviour of its own; every model and migration test (tests/integration/test_foundation_db.py) loads it.
backend.app/jobs/worker.py: RQ worker entry point (queues, connection, signal handling); the jobs suite runs tasks with a SimpleWorker, and the stack's worker container is exercised by the gate's E2E run.
backend.app/schemas/common.py: Shared response and error-envelope helpers; tests/unit/test_errors.py checks the envelope and scripts/check_openapi.py the documented responses they generate.
backend.app/services/auth/account.py: Sessions and device list; tested through the API in tests/security/test_login_sessions.py.
backend.app/services/auth/common.py: AuthDeps and shared helpers of the auth services, used by every auth test.
backend.app/services/auth/credentials.py: Password change, forgot and reset; tested through the API in tests/security/test_login_sessions.py (single-use tokens, expiry, sign-out of every device).
backend.app/services/bidding_terms.py: Too-few-bids actions (D54); tested through the API in tests/security/test_bidding_followups.py (preview, apply, bounds, If-Match, audit, notifications).
backend.app/services/context.py: The acting context (who acts, which session, when) passed to every service; built and asserted in every service test.
backend.app/services/notifications.py: Notification writer; asserted by its effects in tests/security/test_bidding_followups.py and tests/jobs/test_bidding_deadline.py (one notification per closing, per bidder).
backend.app/services/outbox.py: Email outbox writer; tests/jobs/test_email_jobs.py claims, sends and retries the rows it writes.
backend.app/services/public_stats.py: Cached homepage counters; tested through the API in tests/api/test_public.py.

frontend.frontend/src/main.tsx: Browser entry point (mounts the app); exercised by every Playwright run — there is nothing to unit test that rendering the app does not already cover.
frontend.frontend/src/app/App.tsx: Providers and the router outlet; covered by the E2E suite, which loads the real app on every screen of e2e/screens.ts.
frontend.frontend/src/app/router.tsx: Route table; its guards and redirects are unit-tested (src/app/guards.test.tsx) and every route is visited by the E2E screens matrix.
frontend.frontend/src/app/RoleShell.tsx: Chooses the shell for a signed-in role; covered by the shell tests and the E2E runs for each role.
frontend.frontend/src/features/admin: Admin console shell and navigation; Phase 12 builds the console and its tests. Today the bundle is only reachable by a TOTP-verified admin (§14.17), which the E2E a11y run checks.
frontend.frontend/src/features/challenges: Coding challenges; Phase 13 builds the screens and their tests (§17).
frontend.frontend/src/features/devtools: Development-only pages (UI kit, stills) built with VITE_DEV_TOOLS and asserted to be absent from the deployed bundle by the gate (check_no_dev_tools, tests/build/no-inline.test.ts).
frontend.frontend/src/features/legal: Static terms and privacy text; covered by the E2E screens matrix (a11y, responsive, visual).
